items.title: Minecraft Is Getting Its First New Dimension In Over 15 Years
items.summary: Announced today during Minecraft Live, Mojang is adding the first new dimension to the blocky sandbox game in more than a decade and a half. The Sift is an ethereal-looking fourth dimension that was first marketed for Minecraft Dungeons 2 , and it's now been confirmed that it's coming to the base game in 2027.
